now.title: Black Panther
now.text: N'Jobu is King T'Chaka's brother, which makes him the great-uncle of Toussaint through his father, T'Challa. He dies long before Toussaint is born.
now.on_a_card_about_b: N'Jobu's great-nephew, T'Challa's son, born long after N'Jobu's death.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Toussaint's great-uncle, T'Chaka's brother, who died long before he was born.

changes.evidence: Toussaint, Nakia and T'Challa's son, is first revealed in the mid-credits scene of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever. A stage starting at Black Panther names him and T'Challa's son before that reveal; every other Toussaint pair in this chunk starts at Wakanda Forever.

now.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
now.text: Nakia rescues Shuri and Riri Williams from Talokan and kills one of its guards. Namor answers by attacking Wakanda.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Talokan's king, who attacks Wakanda after Nakia kills his guard.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Wakandan who frees Shuri and Riri from Talokan and kills Namor's guard.

proposed.text: Nakia rescues Shuri and Riri Williams from Talokan, killing two of its guards. Namor answers by attacking Wakanda.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Talokan's king, who attacks Wakanda after Nakia kills his guards.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Wakandan who frees Shuri and Riri from Talokan and kills Namor's guards.

changes.evidence: In Wakanda Forever, Nakia breaks Shuri and Williams out of Talokan, killing two Talokanil guards, and Namor retaliates by attacking Wakanda. The stage says she kills one guard.

now.title: Black Panther
now.text: Erik Killmonger is Shuri's cousin. He tries to kill her when he takes the throne.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Killmonger's cousin, whom he tries to kill when he takes the throne.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's cousin, who tries to kill her when he takes the throne.

proposed.text: Erik Killmonger is Shuri's cousin. When T'Challa returns to fight for the throne, Killmonger nearly kills Shuri until T'Challa saves her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Killmonger's cousin, whom he nearly kills in the battle for the throne.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's cousin, who nearly kills her in the battle for the throne.

changes.evidence: In Black Panther, Shuri flees when Killmonger takes the throne; it is later, in the battle after T'Challa returns, that Killmonger overpowers the Dora Milaje and comes close to killing Shuri before T'Challa saves her. The stage puts the attempt at the moment he takes the throne.
